source: E. Rizzi, G. Cocchetti, G. Colasante, F. Rusconi, Analytical and numerical analysis on the collapse mode of circular masonry arches, SAHC 2010, Advanced Materials Research 133-134 (2010) 467-472, doi:10.4028/www.scientific.net/AMR.133-134.467, Table 1, p. 469

definitions.eta: t/r, thickness over centreline radius, at the least thickness
definitions.beta: haunch hinge angle from the crown, degrees
definitions.h: H/(w r), horizontal thrust over w r, with w = gamma t d the weight per unit length of the centreline

solutions.heyman: Heyman's closed form (resultant tangent to the intrados at the haunch)
solutions.ccr: CCR solution, weight uniform along the centreline
solutions.milankovitch: Milankovitch solution, true voussoir weights and centroids
